description: Photograph of Mym Tuma with her works. Mym Tuma, also known as Marilynn Thuma, corresponded with Georgia O'Keeffe from 1964 to 1973. This photograph, and fourteen others, were probably enclosed in a letter from Marilynn Thuma dated September 4, 1970. Handwritten on verso: "These Forms are: Mariposa (Butterfly) 35' x 45'  Almeja (clam) 28' x 36' Cuerno (horn) Only a part of Alcatraz the white lily can be seen on the table 48' x 36' All are in an unfinished state here."
title: Mym Tuma and her works
